description: Is demand in my x402 category coming back? One signed number: 30-day repeat calls in a Bazaar category in the newest complete weekly snapshot (listings whose calls are at least twice their payers, so one-call-per-payer sweeps are left out) against the week before, with the repeat-use listings behind it and the category's share of all repeat calls. Unchanged answers asked with their ETag are a free 304. Price: $0.002 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $0.002 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.

if_none_match.description: Send the answer's ETag back in If-None-Match (over MCP, the if_none_match argument): while the answer is unchanged it comes back as a free 304 Not Modified.
if_none_match.title: If None Match

kyapay-token.description: A Skyfire pay or kya-pay token made for Agoranome's service, from a client that can't set the kyapay-token header. Leave it out when paying with x402 or the header.

name: repeat_demand
title: Repeat demand
